opportunity.action_idea: When a counterparty invoice or payment is received, its price and volume lines are matched against the Sitara deal ticket for that month and mismatches are routed to the deal owner with both values side by side. The deal owner still decides whether the deal or the invoice is wrong and confirms the correction.
opportunity.description: Settlements and counterparties raise price, volume or fee mismatches between invoices or payments and Sitara deal tickets; logistics verifies the deal, disputes the invoice or corrects the deal.
opportunity.formula: 101 messages / 27.38 months observed (farmer-d, giron-d, lokay-m, williams-w3) = 3.69/month; x 20 min median handling x 60% automatable = 0.7 h/month; x $85/h = $63/month
opportunity.name: Deal price and invoice discrepancy resolution
